summary: Frontend-only test of the new interactive Earnings Calculator on /referral-program (public preview URL, SAFE MODE — no forms submitted, no accounts touched). Verified DOM-text rendering of referral-example container, slider, volume readout and all three stat cards; default values; keyboard (Home/End/Arrow) and mouse-drag reactivity across 5 slider positions covering all 4 fee tiers; 12x relation; mobile 390x844 overflow; dark-mode colors; console/page errors. Results: default $50,000/mo -> their fees $500, you/mo $125, 12mo $1,500 (exact match). MAX (End) -> $500,000/mo, $2,500 / $625 / $7,500 (0.5% tier, correct). MIN (Home) -> $1,000/mo, $15 / $4 / $45 (1.5% tier). +5 ArrowRight -> $6,000/mo, $90 / $23 / $270. Drag to ~20% track -> exactly $100,000/mo, $700 / $175 / $2,100 (0.7% tier, correct). All four testids update reactively on both keyboard and drag. No console errors, no page errors. No horizontal overflow at 390x844 (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390; card 342px inside 24px gutters). Dark mode readable (card bg rgb(21,21,27), values rgb(245,245,245) and accent rgb(129,140,248) — good contrast). Only defect: rounding makes the 12-month total not exactly 12x the DISPLAYED monthly figure at low volumes.

ui_bugs.issue: 12-month total is not 12 x the DISPLAYED you-earn/month at low volumes because each value is rounded independently. At $1,000/mo: you/mo shows $4 (3.75 rounded) but 12mo shows $45 (should read $48 if consistent with the displayed monthly). At $6,000/mo: you/mo $23 (22.5) vs 12mo $270 (23x12=276). Underlying math is right; only the display is internally inconsistent. Fix by computing you12mo from the rounded monthly (Math.round(youMonthly)*12) or by rounding the monthly up/using no sub-dollar tiers.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: make the 12-month total consistent with the rounded monthly figure (currently $1,000/mo shows $4/mo but $45 total).
critical_code_review_comments: ReferralEarningsCalculator.tsx: youMonthly/you12mo are each rounded independently in fmtUSD, so the displayed 12mo total can differ from 12 x displayed monthly (rounding drift at low volumes). Derive the total from the rounded monthly.
Component is small, memoized, no API calls, all four key values carry data-testid — no other issues found.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all functional/reactivity/tier/overflow/dark-mode checks pass; 1 low-severity rounding display inconsistency)

seed_data_creation: None — read-only interaction with public marketing page only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calculator verified working end-to-end via DOM inner_text (screenshots of this preview are unreliable/blank on full-page). To drive the slider: focus '[data-testid="referral-calc-slider"] input' then press End/Home/ArrowRight (step 1000), or drag '.MuiSlider-thumb'. Only open item is the low-severity rounding drift between referral-calc-monthly and referral-calc-total at volumes where 25% of fees is not a whole dollar (e.g. $1,000/mo and $6,000/mo).
rca_of_the_issue: fmtUSD applies Math.round() separately to youMonthly and you12mo. you12mo is computed from the unrounded youMonthly, so at $1,000/mo youMonthly = 3.75 -> displays $4 while you12mo = 45 -> displays $45, breaking the stated invariant total = 12 x displayed monthly.
